prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: background-only illustration for the workshop in our portrait sci-fi mobile game. Image 1 is the current workshop backdrop to redesign. Images 2 and 3 are background layers exported from OUR equipment and main-screen PSDs and are the decisive style, color, contrast and depth references. Repaint the workshop as an original, calm, softly defocused blue-gray maintenance hangar in the same lightly illustrated, atmospheric style as the PSDs. Keep only a few broad architectural silhouettes, gentle large planes and subdued cyan ambient light. Reduce tiny machinery, cabinets, crates, rails and hard floor-grid lines dramatically. The central and right areas must be quiet, low-detail mid-tone space so the separately rendered equipment slots, text and small robot remain clear. Camera at a natural human eye level, slight depth, subdued soft-focus layers, matte cool slate-blue and pale steel, sparse muted cyan highlights, no dramatic bloom. Use a wide 3:2 composition with the central 80% safe for a square-ish crop. Produce the clean environment ONLY: no person, robot, aircraft, vehicle, foreground prop, interface, icon, slot, border, label, text, logo or watermark. Do not replicate the aircraft visible in the PSD reference. Maintain the PSD's gentle blue-gray atmosphere instead of crisp photoreal industrial detail.
